_comment: Card L3's scripted lint model (research/configs/l3-lint-fixture.json): a reply per input the lints send over fixtures/faults/model, for every seed or the seeds named. The seed-specific replies plant a miss, a false flag, a malformed reply and a refusal, so the variance script has a spread to report; a pipeline check, never a result.
